value.body: A medical coder reads doctors' notes and reports and translates diagnoses and procedures into standard codes used for insurance billing and health records. In India, most coding work is done for overseas healthcare payers and providers through outsourcing and healthcare IT firms. A typical day is desk-based: reviewing charts and assigning codes to accuracy and productivity targets.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, BPT, B.Pharm, B.Sc life sciences or allied health graduates

items.label: IT-BPM industry headcount (NASSCOM)
items.note: All IT and BPM roles; healthcare coding is one small part

items.label: BPM segment revenue (NASSCOM)
items.note: All business-process work, of which healthcare and medical coding is a share

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join a medical coding company as trainee coders, and many first complete a coding course and a coding certification exam. Anatomy and medical terminology from a BDS, AYUSH or physiotherapy degree give a head start.

value.title: At a glance
items: Work is non-clinical; it does not use hands-on clinical skills.
Shift work aligned to overseas clients is common.
Next roles: senior coder, quality auditor, coding trainer, team lead.

competition.note: BDS graduates in 2023-24 at institutions that reported to AISHE — everyone finishing that degree, not only those entering this role.
